snippet.title: KnowEdge Inbox Desk: Turn Outlook into a controlled workflow queue with drafts, risk flags, and evid
snippet.description:
KnowEdge Inbox Desk is part of the KnowEdge AutoRelease Suite.

Buyer: Busy academics, administrators, consultants, and small business owners
Pain: The inbox hides work, risk, deadlines, and evidence inside an endless message list.
Promise: Urgency/risk routing, reply drafts, evidence notes, and job creation for downstream workflows.

CTA: Export a small inbox sample and see what routes into useful work.

This is a review-first workflow. Human approval remains required.
